test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 08
subject: general
question: A 320 m long train A passes a pole in 24 seconds and passes completely another train B running in the opposite direction at 72 km/h in 21 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will train B take to cross completely a tunnel of length 420 m?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Speed of Train A** = 320 ÷ 24 = 40/3 m/s; **Speed of Train B** = 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/s.

Total distance (A + B) = (Relative Speed) × Time = (40/3 + 20) × 21 = (100/3) × 21 = 700 m.

**Length of Train B** = 700 − 320 = 380 m.

**Time for B to cross tunnel** = (380 + 420) ÷ 20 = 800 ÷ 20 = 40 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 sec.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Length of **Train A** = 320 m, **Time** to pass pole = 24 sec, **Speed of Train B** = 72 km/h, **Time** to cross each other = 21 sec, **Tunnel length** = 420 m.

**Formula Used:** **Speed** = **Distance** ÷ **Time**; Relative speed in opposite direction = Sum of speeds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2ed79b1da5fd8c82700b40fc6fd0905741bad33345a2d391da26e68b28a4fd7.png] 

⇒ Speed of **Train A** (VA) = 320 ÷ 24 = 40/3 m/s

⇒ Speed of **Train B** (VB) = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s

⇒ **Relative Speed** = VA + VB = 40/3 + 20 = (40 + 60)/3 = 100/3 m/s

⇒ Total distance covered during crossing = (100/3) × 21 = 700 m

⇒ **Length of Train B** (LB) = 700 − 320 = 380 m

⇒ Total distance to cross tunnel = LB + **Tunnel length** = 380 + 420 = 800 m

⇒ **Time taken** = 800 ÷ 20 = 40 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 40 sec.**

**__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Crossing a Static Object with Length

When a train of length L₁ crosses a platform or tunnel of length L₂, the total distance to be covered is (L₁ + L₂).

Relative Speed Concept

If two objects move in **opposite directions**, relative speed = S₁ + S₂. If they move in the **same direction**, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|.</p
